question: What is our attrition rate by department?
What is average total compensation by job level?
How has headcount trended over the last 12 months?
Which region has the most open requisitions?

content: This agent answers HR/workforce questions from simulated Workday data.Use mv_headcount for headcount, hires, terminations, attrition and open requisitions by month/department/region.Use mv_compensation for base, total comp and comp-ratio by department and job level.Attrition and comp-ratio are averages/weighted ratios — do not sum them.For point-in-time headcount, filter mv_headcount to a single month.

question: Attrition rate by department
sql: SELECT `Department`, ROUND(MEASURE(`Avg Attrition Rate %`),1) AS attrition_pct FROM de_cert_classic_catalog.workday_hr.mv_headcount GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Headcount trend by month
sql: SELECT `Month`, MEASURE(`Headcount`) AS headcount FROM de_cert_classic_catalog.workday_hr.mv_headcount GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

question: Average total compensation by job level
sql: SELECT `Job Level`, ROUND(MEASURE(`Avg Total Comp`)) AS avg_total_comp FROM de_cert_classic_catalog.workday_hr.mv_compensation GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Total hires vs terminations in the last 12 months?

content: SELECT MEASURE(`Hires`) AS hires, MEASURE(`Terminations`) AS terms FROM de_cert_classic_catalog.workday_hr.mv_headcount WHERE `Month` >= add_months((SELECT MAX(`Month`) FROM de_cert_classic_catalog.workday_hr.mv_headcount), -11)

question: Average comp ratio by job level?

content: SELECT `Job Level`, ROUND(MEASURE(`Avg Comp Ratio`),2) FROM de_cert_classic_catalog.workday_hr.mv_compensation GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: How many open requisitions by region?

content: SELECT `Region`, MEASURE(`Open Requisitions`) FROM de_cert_classic_catalog.workday_hr.mv_headcount GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Which department has the highest average base salary?

content: SELECT `Department`, ROUND(MEASURE(`Avg Base Salary`)) FROM de_cert_classic_catalog.workday_hr.mv_headcount GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: Headcount by region in the latest month?

content: SELECT `Region`, MEASURE(`Headcount`) FROM de_cert_classic_catalog.workday_hr.mv_headcount WHERE `Month`=(SELECT MAX(`Month`) FROM de_cert_classic_catalog.workday_hr.mv_headcount) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2 DESC
